No, we cannot. According to **Purchase Policy §6.2**:

> *"Parts that come into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks and any other item marked food-contact in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. The certificate must be uploaded and checked before the first order is placed. An expired certificate counts as no certificate."*

Since 5-litre gaskets are food-contact parts, we are strictly required to purchase them only from suppliers who hold a valid food-grade certificate, regardless of price.

According to Supplier Policy v2.3 §4.1 (and Purchase Policy §6.2), **"A supplier of any part that comes into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks, and any item marked food-contact in the item master) must hold a food-grade certificate."**

Furthermore, §4.7 notes that *“Bahi does not stop an order to a supplier without a certificate. The check in this section is done by the person raising the order, and by the approver.”*

This means we cannot order food-contact items from a supplier who doesn't have a valid food-grade certificate. Is there another supplier we can use who holds the required certificate, or would you like to check the certificate status of a specific supplier?
